title: Banal Deception & Human-AI Ecosystems: A Study of People’s Perceptions of LLM-generated Deceptive Behaviour
reasoning: The paper investigates the ethical and moral dimensions of LLM-generated deception, focusing on user perceptions of responsibility, trust, and the 'worthiness' of interacting with AI. It explicitly uses a moral perspective in its qualitative interview analysis and discusses ethical frameworks for responsible AI development.
